title: Uniqueness and stability of planar shock wave to 2D compressible Euler equations in the vanishing viscosity limit of compressible Navier-Stokes equations
summary: It is well known that the compressible Euler equations with planar shock initial data may admit infinitely many entropy weak solutions, as shown by Chiodaroli, De Lellis and Kreml [Comm. Pure Appl. Math. (2015)]. In this paper, we introduce a suitable notion of global-in-time weak solutions to the two-dimensional (2D) compressible Navier-Stokes equations with density-dependent viscosities in $\mathbb{R} \times \mathbb{T}$.
